column1: # THE COHERENCE STRIDE -- the 29 open items the eighteen published papers state, against what the
#   register says is open.  GENERATED from 69's census by scripts/build_coherence_stride.py; the RULING
#   and OWNER columns are hand-held and are never regenerated.
# ⚑ WHY THIS PHASE EXISTS, AND IT IS NOT A STRATEGIC QUESTION.  r2695, Daryl: "You can't solve problems
#   in a corpus that's stale all over the place.  If the open problems map is not even a genuine list of
#   open problems ... work the list till it's a legitimate list."
#   ⇒ Node 69's census (r7367_69_the_register_census) read 257 paragraphs across the eighteen published
#   papers, every one in full, and found: ** the register's open list and the papers' open list have
#   almost nothing in common. **  Of 29 distinct open items the papers state, ONE is carried by a live
#   row (PO-50), ELEVEN are stated open while every register row that touched them is STRUCK, and
#   SEVENTEEN have never had a row at all.  P18's own frontier, which the paper calls "complete and
#   unfiltered", lists seven: one live row, six struck.  And ELEVEN places the papers contradict each
#   other about whether something is open -- one-state failures in the published corpus, readable today
#   by anyone opening two papers on the site.
# ⛭⛭ THE SHAPE OF THE WORK, AND IT IS SMALLER THAN THE THREE NUMBERS SUGGEST.
#   It is NOT 11 + 11 + 17 pieces of work.  ** It is 29 items, each needing ONE ruling -- is it open? --
#   and then up to three consequences: **
#     ⒜ the REGISTER: the row goes live, stays struck, or is written for the first time;
#     ⒝ the PAPERS: every paper that states it is rewritten to ONE state (the one-state rule: rewritten
#        to the worked claim, never "was open, later resolved");
#     ⒞ the REMAINDER, in r7013's three kinds: a different kind of object is a ROW, the same question at
#        finer resolution is a STATED LIMIT, and a remainder whose discharge is known is an ORDER.
#   ** One item closes completely before the next.  Nothing leaves this list by reclassification. **
# ⛭ THE RULING TEMPLATE FOR A STRUCK ROW, which is the eleven's whole difficulty.
#   A strike is meant to rest on a receipted answer.  So for each: ** does the strike's ground answer the
#   item the papers state, or something adjacent to it? **
#     * ADJACENT -> the row returns LIVE and the paper was right.  (This is the corpus's most-charged
#       class in another dress: a verdict true of what it examined, taken to license a conclusion about
#       something else.)
#     * IT ANSWERS IT -> the PAPER is stale, and is rewritten to the answer.
#   ⌗ And a third outcome the register could not express until r7371: ** the strike stands as a STOPPING
#   RULE, the item is open, and the row returns live WITH ITS BLOCKER NAMED -- data-gated rather than
#   workable. **  PO-50 is already that shape and was carried as plain OPEN; from here a live row whose
#   discharge waits on a measurement says so in its head, so a reader can tell a workable frontier from
#   a data-gated one.
# ⛔ ORDER OF WORK, and the reason is measured rather than tidy.
#   ① THE CONTRADICTIONS FIRST.  All eleven are live-against-live in print -- a reader can meet both
#     halves today -- and fixing one requires ruling its item anyway, so they are not a separate stage.
#   ② P7 FIRST AMONG THE PAPERS.  It is one side of C1, C2, C3, C6 and C8: ** five of the eleven.  One
#     paper's rewrite clears nearly half the contradictions. **
#   ③ P18's FRONTIER TABLE SECOND.  It is what a reader takes as the programme's open list, and C9 is
#     that list omitting items P18 itself states elsewhere.  ** When this phase ends, P18's frontier
#     table and the register's live rows are the SAME LIST. **
#   ④ THEN the seventeen unrowed items get rows, with their objects named.
#   ⑤ THEN the coherence GATE, below, so the drift cannot recur.
# ⛭⛭ WHAT ENDS THE PHASE, AND IT IS AN INSTRUMENT AND NOT A SWEEP.
#   Nothing in the suite asserts that the register's open list matches the papers'.  That is why the
#   drift was invisible until a census was run by hand.  69's extract.py is the instrument; wrapped as a
#   gate it ratchets: ** every open item the papers state has a live row, and every live row is stated
#   open in a paper or is declared infrastructure. **  Until that gate exists, this list is a measurement
#   that will go stale in silence -- which is this corpus's oldest lesson.
# ⌗ THE PHYSICS WAITS AND THE QUALITY WORK DOES NOT.  Every ruling here is a read of receipts, every
#   registration is an act of registration, and every contradiction is a one-state repair in prose.
#   ** None of it requires doing the physics. **  Opening the physics against a false map is what
#   produced this situation, so the map is made true first.  PO-78 and the Lean line run alongside and
#   are not blocked by it.
# ⛭⛭⛭ r7377 — THE ARCHITECTURE WAS ALREADY THERE, AND FINDING IT CHANGES WHAT THIS PHASE DOES.
#   P7 sec:frontiers carries a comment block, Daryl-directed, stating a standing law:
#     ★ "This is the corpus's ONE open-problems section ... every 'open / frontier / incomplete /
#       remains / not yet / deferred' claim elsewhere in the corpus must reference an item here or be
#       struck as a false-open (the result worked elsewhere, the owed reference supplied).  The law's own
#       home is this section together with THE_REGISTER."
#     ★ "THE BINARY — KILL, or a FAMILY MEMBER ... No third option: 'park' is forbidden."
#   ⇒ So the corpus has FOUR artefacts in this architecture, and three of them are live:
#     ① P7 sec:frontiers — three items (the scalar perturbation sector, WORK; the quantum sector and the
#        matter sector, BOUNDARIES).
#     ② THE_OPEN_PROBLEMS_LEDGER.md — eight numbered families, currency-generated and current to r7371,
#        which declares itself "a view of the register, and the register is the single source of truth",
#        and whose view says ** THREE FAMILIES ARE LIVE: family 3 at PO-31, family 8 at PO-23, family 5's
#        live remainder at PO-56 **.
#     ③ THE_REGISTER — which has STRUCK ALL THREE of those rows.
#     ④ THE_PLAN's canonical opens block — deliberately marked "(historical) the r1241 list", so it is
#        NOT a live mirror and is not a defect.  That demotion was done on purpose and is honest.
# ⛔ ** SO THE DEFECT IS NOT THAT THE PROGRAMME LOST ITS OPEN PROBLEMS.  It keeps them in P7's frontiers
#   section and in the ledger's family view, under a standing law.  What drifted is that the register --
#   which the ledger itself declares the single source of truth -- struck the three rows the other two
#   point at, and neither the view nor the list was updated. **  That is the recurring failure named in
#   this corpus's own standing instructions: retire something and leave everything that references it
#   stale.  69's census found it from the papers' end; this is the same defect seen from the maps' end.
# ⌗ AND THE ASYMMETRY THAT DECIDES EACH CASE: the register's strike is the NEWEST statement, but it is not
#   automatically the right one.  Two of the strikes in question are STOPPING RULES or NON-ATTRIBUTION
#   findings rather than answers, and where that is so the row terminated correctly while the ITEM stayed
#   open -- which is r7013 ①, a different kind of object, and therefore a NEW ROW rather than a lifted
#   strike.
# item\tclass\ttitle\tpapers\tregister\tcontradiction\truling\towner
